A) Liquid water holds its shape.

C) Ice becomes a liquid when it freezes.
D) Solid ice changes shape with its container.

First, evaluate each statement.

A) Liquid water holds its shape. This is false: liquids take the shape of their container; they do not hold a fixed shape. So A is incorrect.

B) Water changes to a gas as it boils. This is true: boiling is the phase transition from liquid to gas (water vapor). So B is correct.

C) Ice becomes a liquid when it freezes. This is false: freezing is liquid to solid; melting is solid to liquid. So C is incorrect.

D) Solid ice changes shape with its container. This is false: solids have a fixed shape; they do not change shape to fit container (unless they are malleable, but ice is rigid). So D is incorrect.

Thus the best answer is B.
